# v0.1.4 preview

This artifact is a preview. It is not a claim of GitHub Actions
equivalence.

The version string is 0.1.4. The capability version is 12.

Job containers use Docker network `none` by default.
`worker --network bridge` opts in to egress. Service containers start
only with that opt-in. A host that upgrades onto a tree where the
job network defaults to `none` adds `--network bridge` on that
host's unit when jobs need egress. Cargo and pip need it. The
repository unit omits the flag.

A job container is created with `--security-opt no-new-privileges`
and `--cap-drop ALL`. Passwordless sudo is off unless the worker is
started with `--passwordless-sudo`.

A bash or sh run script quotes each expression. An expression in
`eval` or in a shell `-c` command is refused. A pull request that
changes a workflow file is refused. A missing pull request author
association is refused.

Every engine call uses the Docker context named `default` unless
`worker --docker-context` or `ROOKRUNNER_DOCKER_CONTEXT` names one.
An inherited `DOCKER_CONTEXT` or `DOCKER_HOST` does not select the
engine.

A host copy of the worker unit must set `NoNewPrivileges=yes`.
The repository unit sets that directive. A copy that omits it is
reported by systemd as `NoNewPrivileges=no` and must be set to `yes`.

The acceptance platform is Linux x86_64. Other platforms are not
claimed. The acceptance interpreter is Python 3.12. The package
requires Python 3.11 or newer.

PyYAML 6.0.3 is installed with the wheel and is not vendored.

The wheel and the source tarball can be built from this tree. They
are not published. This file does not create a tag.

The worker has no listen socket. Write permissions stay rejected.

A poll pass keeps going when an older claimed run has no readable
snapshot. That run is skipped and later runs still post.

The project license is the MIT License.

The App private key is not in the artifact.
